title: Trigger ambiguity / parser-surface conflict
text: Trigger ambiguity / parser-surface conflict: AC18 defines behavior for recognized and unrecognized enablement values but never enumerates the allowed on/off values. Implementers and tests would have to invent the serialization contract; specify the accepted values and their interpretation.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in e8485e6, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
